description:
Read original-post replacement rules for one source and publication destination.
Rules run in list order: {kind: text|url, find: str, replace: str, enabled: bool,
mode?: literal|regex}. Missing mode means literal; literal rules omit mode in responses.
Both modes are case-sensitive. Regex uses RE2; inline (?i), (?m), (?s) are supported.
No lookaround, pattern backreferences or byte matching (\C). \w and \b are ASCII;
use \p{L} for Unicode letters. Text rules replace all non-overlapping matches;
URL rules must match the entire http, https or tg address, including hidden links.
Regex replacements support \1..\99, \g<0>, \g<number>, \g<name>, \\, \n and \t.
Unknown escapes or group references are rejected; unmatched optional groups become empty.
Each resulting URL must be valid. Empty replace deletes the match; find must not be empty.
Empty regex matches are skipped. Album captions are joined with two newlines before matching;
the source footer and destination signature are added afterwards and are not replaced.
Up to 20 rules, with at most 1000 characters in find and replace each.
summary_enabled=true means rules are saved but inactive. Keep revision for saving.
name: get_publication_replacements
title: Get Publication Replacements
